name: N8N Mail WORKFLOW Prototype — Email Triage, Draft Replies, Follow-ups & Weekly Digest

parameters.content:
## N8N Mail WORKFLOW Prototype

**Rule this workflow never breaks: it drafts, it never sends.**
Every reply this workflow writes lands as a Gmail DRAFT. A human always presses Send. Nothing here deletes, sends, or acts on your behalf without you looking at it first.

### What it does
1. Watches your inbox for new mail
2. Classifies each email: LEAD / CLIENT QUESTION / INVOICE / URGENT / IGNORE
3. Drafts a reply for leads & client questions (never sends)
4. Logs invoices to a tracking sheet
5. Pings you instantly for anything urgent
6. Every morning, finds emails YOU sent days ago that nobody answered and drafts a reminder
7. Every Monday, sends you a digest of what's pending

### Before you run it, set up:
- Gmail credential (OAuth2, needs a free Google Cloud project: see SETUP.md) — used to read mail and create drafts
- The Company Profile node filled in with your own details
- An Anthropic API key — add it in n8n as a Header Auth credential (Name: x-api-key) and choose it in the 5 "(Claude)" nodes
- A Google Sheet for invoice tracking (see 'Log Invoice to Sheet' node)
- A Telegram bot (free, via @BotFather) for the urgent alert + weekly digest — swap for Slack/Email if you prefer

See SETUP.md in this folder for the full walkthrough.

## Daily Follow-up Check

Runs once a day. Finds emails YOU sent 3+ days ago that never got a reply, and drafts a polite nudge — as a draft, you still hit send.

Change the number of days in the Company Profile node (follow_up_after_days).

filters.q: =in:sent -in:chats older_than:{{ Number($('Build Profile Text').first().json.follow_up_after_days) || 3 }}d newer_than:{{ (Number($('Build Profile Text').first().json.follow_up_after_days) || 3) + 7 }}d

parameters.content:
## 🏢 COMPANY PROFILE — fill this in first
Open the **Company Profile** node and replace every REPLACE_ME with your real details (services, prices, hours, FAQ, tone, signature). Claude uses ONLY this information when it drafts replies, so the better you fill it, the better the drafts. Fields left as REPLACE_ME are simply ignored — Claude then leaves [BRACKETED PLACEHOLDERS] instead of guessing.
You don't need to touch the other two nodes here.

assignments.name: business_description
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — one or two sentences: what you do and who for

assignments.name: services_and_prices
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — e.g. Website redesign from $1,500; monthly maintenance $120

assignments.name: booking_and_contact
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — e.g. book a free 20-minute call at https://… or reply to this email

assignments.name: faq
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — the questions customers ask most, with your standard answers

assignments.name: tone_of_voice
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — e.g. friendly but professional, uses first names with clients

assignments.name: never_promise
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — e.g. delivery dates, discounts, refunds, anything legal

assignments.name: reply_language
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — leave as is to reply in the sender's language, or write e.g. Italian

assignments.name: signature
assignments.value: REPLACE_ME — e.g. your name and your company, as you want them at the end of a draft
